Libraries

```{r library}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(gtsummary)
library(foreign)
library(janitor)
library(strex)
library(ggtext)
library(plotly)

```

Set global values
```{r}

HIV_reason_list<-c("Donor age or quality", 
                     "Donor medical history, specify", 
                     "Donor social history", 
                     "Positive infectious disease screening test: CMV, HBV, HCV, etc.")

# Removed for patient privacy: the intervention date (day 0). With it, the
# patient timeline's day offsets would give each patient's event dates.
# InterventionDate<-mdy("<removed for patient privacy>")

```


Importing data
```{r import_data}

organ_offers_unprocessed <- read_excel("HIV positive organ offers (Hope Act) clean data.xls")

transplant_data_unprocessed <- read_excel("Updated Hope-Act study Subjects 5-4-2022 Clean.xlsx", 
                                          col_types = c("text", "text", "text", "text",
                                                        "date", "date", "date", "numeric", 
                                                        "numeric", "text", "text"))

```

Processing data

```{r}


transplant_data_processed<-transplant_data_unprocessed%>%
  mutate(duration=as.numeric(End_Date-Date_of_consent))%>%
  uncount(duration)%>%
  group_by(Study_ID)%>%
  mutate(start_date=days(row_number())+Date_of_consent-days(1), stop_date=days(row_number())+Date_of_consent)%>%
  mutate(Post_Intervention=start_date>InterventionDate)%>%
  mutate(Is_Transplant_date=(Date_of_TXP==stop_date))%>%
  mutate(Is_Transplant_date=if_else(is.na(Is_Transplant_date), FALSE, Is_Transplant_date))%>%
  mutate(Transplant_Outcome=ifelse(Is_Transplant_date, Transplanted, 0))%>%
  mutate(HIV_Transplant_Outcome=ifelse(Is_Transplant_date, HIV_transplanted, 0))

names_Study_ID_crosswalk<-transplant_data_unprocessed%>%
  select(Study_ID, Candidate_Last_Name)

organ_offers_processed<-organ_offers_unprocessed%>%
  #Convert string to date format for Match_Date
  mutate(Match_Date=mdy(Match_Date))%>%
  #Remove duplicates
  distinct(PX_ID, Donor_ID, .keep_all=TRUE)%>%
  #Create variable that marks post-intervention period
  mutate(Post_Intervention=Match_Date>InterventionDate)%>%
  #Create variable that marks that organ was transplanted (regardless of where)
  mutate(organ_was_transplanted=case_when(
    Number_of_Kidneys_tranplanted_from_Donor>=1~TRUE,
    Number_of_Kidneys_tranplanted_from_Donor==0~FALSE,
    is.na(Number_of_Kidneys_tranplanted_from_Donor)~FALSE))%>%
  #Create variable that marks whether organ was declined for donor concerns potentially related to HIV status:
  mutate(Potential_HIV_Donor_decline=case_when(
           (Offer_Acceptance=="No") & (Primary_Refusal_Reason %in% HIV_reason_list)~TRUE,
           (Offer_Acceptance=="No") & !(Primary_Refusal_Reason %in% HIV_reason_list)~FALSE,
           !(Offer_Acceptance=="No")~NA
           ))%>%
  #Sort by Donor ID
  arrange(Donor_ID)%>%
  #Add Study_ID to dataset
  left_join(names_Study_ID_crosswalk)%>%
  #Fix one offer that was accepted but not transplanted: the recipient became ineligible before transplant
  # Removed for patient privacy: the record identifier of the corrected offer.
  # mutate(Offer_Acceptance=ifelse(Match_ID==<removed for patient privacy>, "Provisional Acceptance", Offer_Acceptance))

#Remove unneeded object
rm(names_Study_ID_crosswalk)

```

Analyzing data from organ offers

```{r}

#How many distinct patients received organ offers?
length(unique(organ_offers_processed$PX_ID))

#How many distinct organ offers were received?
length(unique(organ_offers_processed$Donor_ID))

organ_offers_processed%>%
  select(HIV_Pos_to_Pos, Match_Date, Offer_Acceptance, Primary_Refusal_Reason, Post_Intervention, 
         organ_was_transplanted, Potential_HIV_Donor_decline)%>%
  tbl_summary()%>%
  as_gt()

organ_offers_processed%>%
  select(Match_Date, Offer_Acceptance, Primary_Refusal_Reason, Post_Intervention, 
         organ_was_transplanted, Potential_HIV_Donor_decline)%>%
  tbl_summary(by=Post_Intervention)%>%
  add_p()%>%
  modify_caption("**Pre and post-intervention data**")

#We specifically look at offers which were declined:
organ_offers_processed%>%
  filter(Offer_Acceptance=="No")%>%
  select(HIV_Pos_to_Pos, Match_Date, Offer_Acceptance, Primary_Refusal_Reason, Post_Intervention, 
         organ_was_transplanted, Potential_HIV_Donor_decline)%>%
  tbl_summary(by=Post_Intervention)%>%
  add_p()%>%
  modify_caption("**Pre and post-intervention data**")

organ_offers_processed%>%
    filter(Offer_Acceptance=="No")%>%
  select(Post_Intervention, organ_was_transplanted, Potential_HIV_Donor_decline)%>%
    tbl_strata(
    strata = Post_Intervention,
    .tbl_fun =
      ~ .x %>%
        tbl_summary(by = Potential_HIV_Donor_decline) %>%
        add_n(),
    .header = "**{strata}**, N = {n}"
  )%>%
  modify_caption("**Organ acceptance elsewhere in patients whose reason for decline was HIV-related, stratified by intervention period**")


```

```{r}

#Poisson GLM, all transplants as outcome
m1 <- glm(Transplant_Outcome ~Post_Intervention , family="poisson", data=transplant_data_processed)
m1%>%tbl_regression(exponentiate=TRUE)

#Poisson GLM, HIV D+ transplants as outcome
m2 <- glm(HIV_Transplant_Outcome ~Post_Intervention , family="poisson", data=transplant_data_processed)
m2%>%tbl_regression(exponentiate=TRUE)


```

Plot patient timeline
```{r}
#Create data sets needed for a patient timeline
graphic_data_points_1<-organ_offers_processed%>%
  mutate(Event=case_when(
    Offer_Acceptance=="No"~"HIV offer declined",
    Offer_Acceptance=="Provisional Acceptance"~"HIV offer accepted, but not transplanted",
    Offer_Acceptance=="Yes"~"HIV offer accepted and transplanted"))%>%
  rename(Event_Date=Match_Date)%>%
  select(Study_ID, Event_Date, Event)
  
graphic_data_points_2<-transplant_data_unprocessed%>%
  filter(HIV_transplanted==0)%>%
  mutate(Event=case_when(
    Transplanted==1 & HIV_transplanted==0~"Non-HIV offer accepted and transplanted",
    str_detect(Listing_Status, "Deceased")~"Death",
    str_detect(Listing_Status, "Withdrawn")~"Permanently delisted",
    TRUE~"End of study period"))%>%
    rename(Event_Date=End_Date)%>%
    select(Study_ID, Event_Date, Event)

graphic_data_points<-rbind(graphic_data_points_1, graphic_data_points_2)%>%
  mutate(endpoint=as.numeric(as.Date(Event_Date)-as.Date(InterventionDate)))%>%
  mutate(Study_ID=as.factor(Study_ID))%>%
  select(-Event_Date)

rm(graphic_data_points_1, graphic_data_points_2)


graphic_data_lines<-transplant_data_unprocessed%>%
  mutate(End_Date=as.Date(End_Date))%>%
  mutate(Date_of_consent=as.Date(Date_of_consent))%>%
  mutate(InterventionDate=as.Date(InterventionDate))%>%
  mutate(endpoint_right=as.numeric(as.Date(End_Date)-as.Date(InterventionDate)))%>%
  mutate(endpoint_left=as.numeric(as.Date(Date_of_consent)-as.Date(InterventionDate)))%>%
  mutate(endpoint1_left=case_when(
    endpoint_left<0~endpoint_left,
    endpoint_left>=0~NA_real_))%>%
  mutate(endpoint1_right=case_when(
    endpoint_left<0 & endpoint_right>0~0,
    endpoint_left<0 & endpoint_right<0~endpoint_right,
    endpoint_left>=0~NA_real_))%>%
  mutate(endpoint2_left=case_when(
    endpoint_left<0 & endpoint_right>0~0,
    endpoint_left>0 & endpoint_right>0~endpoint_left,
    endpoint_right<=0~NA_real_))%>%
  
  mutate(endpoint2_right=case_when(
    endpoint_right>0~endpoint_right,
    endpoint_right<=0~NA_real_))%>%
  
  select(Study_ID, endpoint1_left, endpoint1_right, endpoint2_left, endpoint2_right)%>%
  mutate(Study_ID=as.factor(Study_ID))


  
  #Plot patient timelines
  
  plot1<-ggplot()+
  geom_segment(data=graphic_data_lines, mapping = aes(x=endpoint2_left, xend=endpoint2_right, 
                                                      y=Study_ID, yend=Study_ID), 
                                                      color="blue")+
  geom_segment(data=graphic_data_lines, mapping = aes(x=endpoint1_left, xend=endpoint1_right, 
                             y=Study_ID, yend=Study_ID), 
                             color="red")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0)+
  geom_point(data=graphic_data_points, mapping=aes(x=endpoint, y=Study_ID, 
                                                   color=Event, shape=Event), 
             alpha=0.7)+
  labs(y= "Study ID", x = "Days before or after study intervention (Date of Intervention=0)")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-1095,720,365))+
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(0,1,2,3,4,5,6))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position="bottom")
  
    #Plot patient timelines
  
  ggplot()+
  geom_segment(data=graphic_data_lines, mapping = aes(x=endpoint2_left, xend=endpoint2_right, 
                                                      y=Study_ID, yend=Study_ID), 
                                                      color="blue")+
  geom_segment(data=graphic_data_lines, mapping = aes(x=endpoint1_left, xend=endpoint1_right, 
                             y=Study_ID, yend=Study_ID), 
                             color="red")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0)+
  geom_point(data=graphic_data_points, mapping=aes(x=endpoint, y=Study_ID, 
                                                   color=Event, shape=Event), 
             alpha=0.7)+
  labs(y= "Study ID", x = "Days before or after study intervention (Date of Intervention=0)")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-1095,720,365))+
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(0,1,2,3,4,5,6))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position="bottom")
    
  ggplotly(plot1, tooltip = c("y","color"))%>% 
    layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.2))
    
    

```


Demographics
```{r}

Demographics <- read_excel("<data folder>/Hope_Act_Excelsheet_9-18-2023.xlsx")%>%
  clean_names()%>%
  rename(recipient_age_yrs=age_yrs)%>%
  rename(recipient_sex=sex_10)%>%
  rename(recipient_race=race_11)%>%
  rename(recipient_ethnicity=ethnicity_12)%>%
  rename(donor_sex=sex_26)%>%
  rename(donor_race=race_27)%>%
  rename(donor_ethnicity=ethnicity_28)%>%
  mutate(PRA_1=str_first_number(class_i_pra_percent))%>%
  mutate(PRA_2=str_first_number(class_ii_pra_percent))%>%
  mutate(years_on_dialysis=str_first_number(time_on_dialysis))%>%
  mutate(months_on_dialysis=str_nth_number(time_on_dialysis, n = 2))%>%
  mutate(months_on_dialysis=ifelse(is.na(months_on_dialysis), 0, months_on_dialysis))%>%
  mutate(time_on_hd_years=years_on_dialysis+(1/12)*(months_on_dialysis))%>%
  mutate(donor_age_years=str_first_number(donor_age))%>%
  mutate(warm_ischemia_min=str_first_number(warm_ischemia_time))%>%
  mutate(cold_ischemia_hours=str_first_number(cold_ischemia_time))%>%
  mutate(cold_ischemia_min=str_nth_number(cold_ischemia_time, n = 2))%>%
  mutate(cold_ischemia_total=cold_ischemia_hours+(1/60)*cold_ischemia_min)%>%
  mutate(EndStatus=case_when(
    hiv_transplanted==1~"Transplanted from HIV D+ donor",
    hiv_transplanted==0 & transplanted==1~"Transplanted from HIV D- donor",
    TRUE~"Not transplanted"))%>%
  mutate(recipient_hcv_binary=ifelse(str_detect(recipient_hcv, "Negative"), "Negative", "Positive"))%>%
  mutate(PRA_2_binary=ifelse(PRA_2==0, "Zero", "Greather than zero"))


#Medians
Demographics%>%
  select(starts_with("recipient"), time_on_hd_years,PRA_1, PRA_2_binary, EndStatus)%>%
  select(-recipient_hcv)%>%
  tbl_summary(by=EndStatus)%>%
  add_p()%>%
  bold_labels()%>%
  add_overall()%>%
  as_gt()

Demographics%>%
  filter(!EndStatus=="Not transplanted")%>%
  select(warm_ischemia_min, cold_ischemia_total,starts_with("donor"), dcd_or_dbd, terminal_creatinine, EndStatus)%>%
  select(-donor_age)%>%
  tbl_summary(by=EndStatus)%>%
  add_p()%>%
  bold_labels()%>%
  add_overall()%>%
  as_gt()

#Means
Demographics%>%
  select(starts_with("recipient"), time_on_hd_years,PRA_1, PRA_2_binary, EndStatus)%>%
  select(-recipient_hcv)%>%
  tbl_summary(by=EndStatus,
              statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})"),
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 1)%>%
  add_p(test=all_continuous()~"aov")%>%
  bold_labels()%>%
  add_overall()%>%
  as_gt()

Demographics%>%
  filter(!EndStatus=="Not transplanted")%>%
  select(warm_ischemia_min, cold_ischemia_total,starts_with("donor"), dcd_or_dbd, terminal_creatinine, EndStatus)%>%
  select(-donor_age)%>%
  tbl_summary(by=EndStatus,
              statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})"),
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 1)%>%
  add_p(test=all_continuous()~"t.test")%>%
  bold_labels()%>%
  add_overall()%>%
  as_gt()





Table1A<-Demographics%>%
  select(starts_with("recipient"), time_on_hd_years,PRA_1, PRA_2, EndStatus)%>%
  select(-recipient_hcv)%>%
  tbl_summary(by=EndStatus)%>%
  add_p()%>%
  bold_labels()%>%
  add_overall()

Table1B<-Demographics%>%
  filter(!EndStatus=="Not transplanted")%>%
  select(warm_ischemia_min, cold_ischemia_total,starts_with("donor"), dcd_or_dbd, terminal_creatinine, EndStatus)%>%
  select(-donor_age)%>%
  tbl_summary(by=EndStatus)%>%
  add_p()%>%
  bold_labels()%>%
  add_overall()

#Don't use--columns stack in wrong order
tbl_stack(list(Table1A, Table1B))


```
